Each ROM and IC must be mounted into the proper IC Socket. For VS.DUAL SYSTEM (two monitors): If “VS. SLALOM” is to be installed in main (left) side of cabinet, then EPROMs and Custom IC should use locations 1A, 1B, 1C, 1D, 2B and 2F. For sub (right) side, use locations 6A, 6B, 6C, 6D, 8B and 8F.
